children: Press Metal Aluminium could report sequentially lower 3Q earnings as lower aluminum prices and higher raw material costs squeeze margins, Affin Hwang IB analyst Andrew Lim says in a note. He tips 3Q earnings to weaken to 500 million ringgit-600 million ringgit from 718 million ringgit in 2Q. Aluminum prices are expected to find near-term support from tight global supply, although momentum may moderate, he says. Higher carbon anode costs are expected to weigh on earnings, prompting Lim to cut his 2027-2028 earnings forecasts by 10%-11%. Affin Hwang downgrades Press Metal to hold from buy, and cuts its target price to 7.70 ringgit from 9.40 ringgit, citing less-favorable raw material price trends and a plateau in aluminium price momentum. Shares are 1.0% lower at 7.10 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
